name: Wajima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Wajima city emblem in green and blue: a green disc crossed by a blue stylised bird-like swoosh.
history: Municipal flag of Wajima, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 2006.

features.role: Wajima city emblem — a green disc crossed by a blue stylised bird-like swoosh
